In our project we are doing the food detection from the image and calculating the calories of each food item which is present in the plate. Main problem we faced is that there is no proper dataset available for the Indian foods, so we have collected the images by ourself from the college canteen and mess. Total 700 images we have collected and for each image we have done the labelling of each food item manually. For the model we have used YOLOv8 because it is giving the good speed and it can detect the multiple objects in single image only. Initially the accuracy was coming very less, around 40 percent only, because the model was getting confused in between dal and sambar since both are looking almost same in the image. After adding more number of images for these classes, accuracy has increased up to 71 percent. For calculating the calories we are taking the average portion size from the nutrition table, but this is not giving exact value when the quantity is more or less. In future we are planning to use the plate size for finding the actual quantity of food.
